parameters.name: DatasetId
parameters.description: The ID of the dataset. For more information, see [ListDatasets](~~457222~~).

parameters.name: LabelKeys
parameters.description: The label keys used to filter the dataset list. Datasets are returned if their label keys contain the specified strings.

parameters.name: LabelValues
parameters.description: The label values used to filter the dataset list. Datasets are returned if their label values contain the specified strings.

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description:
The sort order for the paged query. The default value is ASC. Valid values:

- ASC: Ascending order.

- DESC: Descending order.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. The value starts from 1. The default is 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. The default value is 10.

parameters.name: Properties
parameters.description:
The dataset properties. Valid values:

- DIRECTORY: Folder.

- FILE: File.

parameters.name: SortBy
parameters.description:
The field to use for sorting in a paged query. The default value is GmtCreateTime. Valid values:

- GmtCreateTime (default): Creation time.

- GmtModifiedTime: Modification time.

- SourceType

- DataSourceType

- Property

- DataSize

- DataCount

parameters.name: SourceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the data source.

- If SourceTypes is USER, you can specify a custom ID.

- If SourceTypes is ITAG, this is the ID of the iTAG annotation task.

- If SourceTypes is PAI\_PUBLIC\_DATASET, this parameter is empty by default.

parameters.name: SourceTypes
parameters.description:
The source type. Valid values:

- PAI-PUBLIC-DATASET: A public dataset from PAI.

- ITAG: A dataset generated from the annotation results of the iTAG module.

- USER: A dataset registered by a user.
